title: Sequenced recommendation activation with operator latches
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Goal: Implement a conservative, operator-controlled rollout mechanism that can safely auto-apply batching and KV-caching recommendations from Optimize while minimizing customer impact and enabling fast rollback. The system should support sequenced activations (staged percentage + time windows), a preflight simulation against replayed traffic, telemetry gating, and an operator latch/approval step for final commit. This ticket covers the core controller, API hooks, telemetry thresholds, Console approval UI, and runbook updates.
acceptance_criteria: Controller can receive a recommended config bundle and create a 3-stage rollout plan (staging: 1% traffic dry-run, canary: 10% simulated/real, ramp: 50%/100% increments)
Preflight simulation runs on a 24h traffic window and produces delta estimates for p50/p95 latency, per-request token cost, and error rate with a 95% confidence interval
Automated rollback triggers: absolute latency increase >50ms OR relative p95 increase >15% OR error rate increase >0.5% over baseline during canary; triggers halt rollout and notify operator
Console UI surfaces per-stage telemetry, estimated cost delta, and one-click operator latch (approve/hold/revert) with audit log entry
E2E tests exercising simulated canary, rollback path, and dry-run validation exist and pass in CI
Runbook created with operator checklist, escalation path, and postmortem template
implementation_notes: We will prioritize minimal blast radius: start with read-only dry-run and simulator for non-customer-facing canaries. The controller will be implemented as a new service (recommendation-enforcer) backed by the rollout-store (persisted k/v in Postgres). It will integrate with: 1) optimizer API (pull recommendations), 2) runtime router (apply traffic-split via existing routing proxy feature flags), 3) telemetry service (ingest and compute short-window deltas), 4) Console (approval UI + audit trail). Use feature-flag gating to turn on for internal pilot orgs only.
risks_considerations: Simulator fidelity: replay vs live traffic may under/over-estimate risk — mitigate by conservative safety margins and manual operator inspection
Rollback speed: full revert for kernel-level quantized changes may take time — ensure fallback model variant is available for instant route swap
Telemetry noise: low-volume canaries may produce noisy signals; include minimum sample size before evaluating triggers
Permission model: accidental auto-apply must be prevented via RBAC + operator latches; coordinate with security for SSO role mappings
